page.contract_project_risk_block: Laser cutters can cut automatically and CNC brakes can bend by program, but experienced workers still lay out complex parts, adjust pieces that do not fit on site, and hammer the right curve. Machines save effort, not craftsmanship.

responsibilities: Calculate and fabricate sheet metal parts

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「只会基础手工不学数控」——会编程、能安装、懂图纸的钣金工，才扛得住自动化迭代。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险来自「数控与自动化的普及」：激光切割、数控折弯正在接走下料折弯的重复环节，纯手工作业被压缩；但复杂件放样、现场安装调整和焊接手艺，短期内离不开熟练的钣金师傅。
risks: 激光切割与数控折弯替代手工下料
纯手工岗位减少，要求技能升级
车间噪音粉尘，劳动保护要跟上
工地安装出差多，环境艰苦
收入看计件与技能，波动大

page.contract_project_risk_block: 激光切割机能自动下料、数控折弯机能按程序折弯，但复杂件的放样、现场装不上的调整、敲出来的那道弧线，还得靠老师傅。钣金是「算出来再敲出来」的活，机器省了力气，省不了手艺。

career_path_block.说明: AI apps can handle some tasks
Organizations compete to hire these specialists

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest risk for speech-language pathology assistants is not AI, but remaining at the assistant level. Pursue certification and specialized cases. The stronger AI becomes, the scarcer your expertise will be.
career_risk_cards.fact: The main job risk is the career ceiling. Assistant roles depend on licensed therapists, and advancement requires speech-language therapist licensure. At the same time, AI speech training apps are diverting some mild cases, reducing the volume of basic repetitive training.
risks: Advancement bottleneck: Assistants without licensure hit a career ceiling
Voice strain: Speaking all day causes occupational wear
Case pressure: Parents question the trainer when progress stalls
AI diversion: Apps take over mild training cases
Low starting pay: Compensation is modest at the assistant level

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can teach pronunciation, but it cannot create the trust behind the moment when someone finally chooses to speak. A trainer's value comes from being present for every practice attempt.

career_risk_cards.callout: 语言助理最大的风险不是 AI，而是「停在助理层不动」——把考证和专长个案做起来，AI 越强，你的稀缺性越高。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位风险主要是「职业天花板」：助理岗位依附于持证治疗师，晋升要考言语治疗师执照；同时 AI 语音训练 App 分流了部分轻度个案，低阶重复训练的量在减少。
risks: 晋升瓶颈：助理不持证就卡在天花板
嗓子损耗：天天说话职业伤
个案压力：没进步时被家长质疑
AI 分流：轻度训练被 App 承接
收入起步低：助理阶段待遇一般

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能教人发音，教不了「他今天终于愿意开口」的那份信任——训练师的存在感，来自每一次有人陪着练。

career_path_block.路径: Only scans goods and does not learn systems

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is automation + accountability for accuracy. Robots take over routine travel, and people who neither learn systems nor resolve exceptions face the greatest danger.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risks are automation + accountability for accuracy. Automated storage systems and sorting robots eliminate many standardized roles, while workers are held accountable for picking and shipping errors. Those who cannot use systems and do not learn new equipment face the greatest danger.
risks: Automated storage systems eliminate standardized roles
Accountability for picking and shipping errors
High intensity during major promotions
Demanding warehouse walking
Scanning-only work is easily replaced

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how well systems provide directions, people still put away the goods, investigate errors, and prioritize rush orders. Humans cannot be fully removed from this end of warehouse distribution.

responsibilities: Receive, put away, and replenish goods

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险是「自动化 + 精度追责」——走位被机器人吃，不学系统不处置异常的人最危险。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险是「自动化 + 精度追责」——自动立库和分拣机器人吃大量标准岗，同时拣错发错要追责，不会用系统、不学新设备的人最危险。
risks: 自动立库吃标准岗
拣错发错追责
大促高强度
仓库走动辛苦
纯扫货易被替

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多会指路，货还是人上的、错还是人查的、急单还是人插的——仓配这头，人撤不干净。

career_path_block.说明: Handles materials and odd jobs, low income

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risks for tile setters are physical wear and a craft-generation gap, not AI. Machines cannot replace your hands, but your back and knees can make the decision first.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risks are physical wear and construction-site safety, not AI. Prolonged kneeling damages the back and knees, while cutting dust and noise harm the lungs and hearing. Schedule pressure often brings overtime, and inadequate protection can cause accidents. These are unavoidable costs of a physical craft.
risks: Physical wear: back and knee injuries, dust and noise exposure
Work injury risk: frequent cutting and handling accidents
Income variability: piece-rate earnings fluctuate seasonally
Age gap: few younger workers enter
Process evolution: rates stagnate without learning new methods

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how precisely machines cut tile, they cannot replace the craft of a worker kneeling on the floor with trowel and mallet. Installation quality will always remain in human hands.

responsibilities: Prepare the substrate and lay out lines
Cut and set tile and stone
Grout, cure, and protect finished work
skills: Grouting, decorative joint finishing, and curing

career_risk_cards.callout: 瓷砖工最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「身体损耗 + 工艺断层」——机器替代不了你的手，但腰和膝会先替你做决定。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「身体损耗与工地安全」——长期蹲跪作业伤腰伤膝，切割粉尘和噪音伤肺伤耳；赶工期时加班多，安全防护不到位容易出事，这是体力工匠绕不开的代价。
risks: 身体损耗：腰膝损伤与粉尘噪音
工伤风险：切割搬运意外多
收入波动：计件受淡旺季影响
年龄断层：年轻劳动力流入少
工艺迭代：不学新工艺单价上不去

page.contract_project_risk_block: 机器能把砖切得再准，也替不了师傅跪在地上那一铲一锤的功夫——铺贴的质量，永远在人的手里。
